what: Suncor Energy is a Canadian integrated oil company. It mines and upgrades oil sands bitumen in Alberta, refines it in Canada, and sells fuel through the Petro-Canada service station network.
customers: Canadian motorists through Petro-Canada stations, refiners and crude buyers in North America.
money: mining, in-situ production and upgrading in Alberta
four refineries and the Petro-Canada retail network
moat: Owning the barrel from the mine to the petrol pump, so it captures the refining margin when crude prices are weak and the production margin when they are strong.
risks: Oil sands operations had years of safety and reliability problems before a management change
Canadian heavy crude trades at a discount to world prices
Carbon costs in Canada rise over time
opportunities: Reliability and cost performance have improved markedly since 2023
Petro-Canada gives a steady retail margin that pure producers lack
Net margin of 11% with low debt relative to cash flow
watch: Oil sands production and upgrader utilisation rates.
